parent_turns: im making dinner. kid wants a challenge. 5 min, just the big plastic cups already out. give me one thing we can start now

desired_experience: One concrete first action using the available cups.
A playable child-sized challenge with little adult preparation and a clear stopping point.
common_misses: A list of options or a balance lecture.
New supplies, worksheets, or a generic safety preamble.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must invent the challenge or leave dinner to prepare it.

parent_turns: We are late for school. Why did the little ice piece melt before the big one? Give me something short I can say out loud.

desired_experience: A short, concrete explanation of the comparison.
Wording a parent can say without translating it.
common_misses: A full experiment or vocabulary lesson.
A materially misleading simplification.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must translate or shorten the explanation.

parent_turns: Can you give us a silly rhyming game while we wait? No paper and my kid cannot read yet.

desired_experience: A playable spoken game with actual starting words.
A playful turn the child can take without reading.
common_misses: Only telling the parent to think of rhymes.
Writing, flashcards, or a formal test.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must invent the words and rules.

parent_turns: I am exhausted. We have three minutes before bath. One tiny movement game, no setup.

desired_experience: One brief game with bodies and the existing space.
Simple parent words and an obvious end.
common_misses: Multiple options, hidden materials, or a prolonged lesson.
Repeated confirmation before giving the game.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must choose among options or prepare anything.

parent_turns: Both kids want to help with the clean socks. Make it one little game they can do together. The younger one does not read.

desired_experience: One shared activity with a meaningful way for each child to participate.
Uses existing socks and requires no reading.
common_misses: Two separate lesson plans.
Adult judging or elaborate scoring.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must run two activities or constantly referee.

parent_turns: We are looking for shapes around the living room. Make this more fun, but no worksheet and no writing.

desired_experience: A specific playful move extending the hunt.
Pointing, movement, or spoken participation works.
common_misses: A printed chart, writing, or quiz at each find.
Generic instructions with no actual game.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must create a recording system or redesign the hunt.

parent_turns: My kid made a strange creature out of blocks. Give me one playful thing to say that helps the story keep going.

desired_experience: One usable imaginative prompt tied to the creature.
Room for the child to decide what happens.
common_misses: A construction challenge, test, or assessment.
An explanation of developmental skills.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must convert pedagogy advice into actual words.

parent_turns: Just saving this: we spent ages watching ants carry crumbs at the park today.

desired_experience: Brief acknowledgment respecting a context-only note.
common_misses: An unsolicited lesson, printable, or interrogation.
A claim of mastery or a durable child trait.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must manage unwanted follow-up work.

parent_turns: Why does the Moon look like it is coming with us in the car? One simple explanation please.

desired_experience: A concrete near/far explanation that answers the question.
Short enough to read aloud naturally.
common_misses: An unnecessary activity or decorative-image delay.
A generic statement that never explains apparent movement.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must find or invent the actual explanation.

parent_turns: Make a one-page picture clue hunt for our walk: leaves, stones, and sticks. My kid does not read yet. We want to point at the page and find things.

desired_experience: The delivered page visibly supports finding the actual three kinds of objects.
Large targets, little reading, and no parent drawing required.
common_misses: A prose scavenger-hunt plan in a PDF.
Decorative nature art without usable clue targets.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must draw the clues or explain every box.

parent_turns: We have washable paint and are going to mix two colors. Make a visual prediction-and-result page. Leave the result for us to discover.

desired_experience: A visible action/setup cue and generous prediction/result spaces.
The child can record observed color without writing; response roles are clear.
Preserves discovery.
common_misses: A printed answer spoiling the observation.
Refusing the sensory topic or substituting a generic fair-test page.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must reconstruct the setup or redraw response areas.

parent_turns: Give us one playful thing to build with this single sheet of paper. We have no scissors or tape.

desired_experience: A concrete build using the available material.
A clear way to try or enjoy the result.
common_misses: Extra materials or advance preparation.
A list of possibilities without usable instructions.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must search for instructions or missing supplies.

parent_turns: Make a one-page picture clue hunt for leaves, stones, and sticks. It is for a child who cannot read yet.
Keep those same clues, but make the pictures much bigger and remove the writing lines.

desired_experience: Final page visibly enlarges the same clues and removes writing lines.
Preserves the original usable activity and delivers the revised page.
common_misses: A new activity or substituted clues.
Only saying the page changed.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must repeat the correction or fix the page.

parent_turns: Give us one little game about the sounds we can hear in this room.
Another idea please. Something we do differently, not the same listening game with different sounds.

desired_experience: A substantively different child action that still explores sound.
Enough concrete content to begin.
common_misses: Renaming the same listening activity.
Abandoning the subject.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must invent the promised alternative.

parent_turns: Help me explain why plants need light.
That is too much to read. Keep the same idea but give me two sentences I can say to my kindergartener. No activity.

desired_experience: Core idea preserved in two short spoken sentences.
Final turn respects no activity.
common_misses: Repeating the long explanation or adding a quiz.
Unsupported simplification.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must shorten and fact-check it again.

parent_turns: My kid keeps asking why when I explain things. Give me one natural thing to say when I do not know the answer.

desired_experience: Actual parent words honestly acknowledging uncertainty and preserving curiosity.
Brief support without requiring teaching preparation.
common_misses: A behavior-management lecture or child profile.
Turning parent support into a lesson.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must translate advice into a natural reply.

parent_turns: We noticed our shadows outside. One funny thing to try right here, no supplies and no worksheet.

desired_experience: An immediate playful action tied to visible shadows.
Enough direction to try it without a lecture.
common_misses: A page, supplies, or formal trials.
A misleading explanation of what the activity demonstrates.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must devise the action or over-organize play.

parent_turns: The kids are playing restaurant. Help them keep going together with one little twist. Please do not turn it into a math lesson.

desired_experience: A concrete role/story twist in the existing shared play.
Both children participate without adult preparation.
common_misses: Required counting, worksheets, or competition.
Separate school-style tasks.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must manage the game or undo an unwanted lesson.

parent_turns: We have a large toy magnet and a few objects to try. Make a visual page for guessing what it will attract and showing what happened.

desired_experience: Visible setup/action and usable prediction/result spaces.
Clear labels and roles; observations remain open.
common_misses: An answer key presented as if objects were tested.
A generic Predict/Try/Notice banner as the only activity visual.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must explain or draw the testing surface.

parent_turns: Make a short clapping game we can do now. My kid does not read music. Give us the actual pattern to start with.

desired_experience: A concrete starting pattern through simple spoken/visual cues.
A brief turn or playful variation.
common_misses: Advice to create a rhythm without providing one.
Notation needing another lesson first.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must invent or translate the pattern.

parent_turns: Make a picture-card story about a lost mitten finding its way home. We want to put the cards in order and tell it together. Very little reading.

desired_experience: Delivered cards supply actual events with recognizable visual differences.
Usable sequencing and shared-storytelling layout.
common_misses: Telling the parent to draw the cards.
Text-heavy cards with tiny decoration.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must make the story materials or read every event.

parent_turns: We have a toy car and cushions on the floor. Give us a tiny adventure with an actual route to follow. No printing.

desired_experience: A concrete short route/adventure using supplied objects.
A few usable spoken directions.
common_misses: A planning worksheet or list of ideas without a route.
Setup longer than the play.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must invent the route and story.

parent_turns: Make a visual challenge about sharing seven big blocks between two toy animals. Let us find different ways.

desired_experience: Requested quantities represented accurately.
Usable space/pieces for multiple arrangements without excessive writing.
common_misses: Incorrect or confusing counts.
One printed winning answer closing exploration.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must correct quantities or create the visual task.

parent_turns: My kid thinks a cloud looks like a rabbit. Help me explain how a cloud can change shape, without spoiling the pretend rabbit story.

desired_experience: A brief child-ready explanation of changing cloud shape.
Room for imaginative interpretation.
common_misses: Correcting pretend play or replacing it with a lesson.
A poetic answer that never explains the change.
review.parent_burden_to_watch: Parent must balance explanation and pretend play alone.
